name: SOC-009: Windows Data Exfiltration Detected
description: Detects data exfiltration attempts on Windows including PowerShell upload cmdlets, certutil abuse, BITS transfers, and external archiving/sync tools.
aql_expression: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as EventName, sourceIP, destinationIP, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) as LogSource, payload, starttime FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) ILIKE '%Windows%' AND (payload ILIKE '%Invoke-WebRequest%' OR payload ILIKE '%System.Net.WebClient%' OR payload ILIKE '%Start-BitsTransfer%' OR payload ILIKE '%certutil%-encode%' OR payload ILIKE '%bitsadmin%/transfer%' OR payload ILIKE '%rclone%' OR payload ILIKE '%mega-cmd%') ORDER BY starttime DESC LAST 300 SECONDS
